description: NIST's CTC-04, its AP242 e1 edition's cylinder face #11285 and sphere face #13013 as a two-face sheet. Their shared edge #11276 lies 0.0506 off one of them, past the read cap of 0.01, so the read grows its tolerance and its two vertices' to the gap and names them (ADR-0058); Open CASCADE carries it at 0.0493. A healed boundary is only known to within its edge's tolerance, so the sheet's area is known to within the strip it sweeps, gap × length = 0.0506 × 7.85 = 0.398 mm², 3.8e-4 relative; Open CASCADE's area differs by 8.6e-8. The area tolerance is that band; the centroid's that band times the sheet's diagonal (135) over its area, 0.051; the inertia's that band times the diagonal squared over the tensor's largest component, 4.5e-3
